subject: Controlled change evidence and follow-up for Nimbus security review
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@northbridge-assess.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@nimbus-finance.com>, security.ops@nimbus-finance.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Controlled-change evidence (SDLC) for Nimbus scoped items

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Nimbus' audit team has a few follow-ups focused on controlled-change evidence for the components in scope (inference-serving runtime and the deployment orchestration). They asked for: 

- A succinct mapping of SDLC controls to artifacts (code review policy, PR gating, CI/CD controls, secrets handling).
- A recent example of a production change that followed the full flow (PR -> CI gates -> canary -> rollout), including the approvals and rollback events.
- Proof of encryption and rotation for secrets used in CI (where feasible, redacted).

Deliverables can be zipped or shared links. Nimbus expects this by EOD Monday (2026-12-21) to stay on track for their review.

Can you point me to the right owner and confirm whether Redwood can provide redacted logs?

Best,
Elena
Elena Morris
Senior Assessor, Northbridge Assessments

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@northbridge-assess.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Controlled-change evidence (SDLC) for Nimbus scoped items

Elena —

Thanks for the list. I own the evidence bundle for SDLC controls across infra and serving. We can provide the artifacts you mentioned; attaching a mapped matrix and a secrets playbook (redacted). For the PR/CI example, I can extract the PR gating logs and the canary rollout timeline — those are ~2GB of logs so I'll provide a redacted run log and a summarized timeline.

Quick notes:
- Code review: enforced 2 approvers for critical path (runtime code) and 1 approver for config-only changes. PR gating is enforced by our CI policy (job: pr-gate-critical).
- CI/CD controls: build provenance is recorded; artifacts signed with internal key.
- Secrets: CI uses ephemeral deploy tokens stored in AWS Secrets Manager; rotation policy is 30d and enforced by a scheduled job.
- Change approvals: automated approvals for docs/config changes; manual approval (on-call + eng manager) required for production-facing runtime changes.

I will share: sdlc_controls_matrix_v2.xlsx, secrets-management-playbook.pdf, and a redacted CI run log ci_cd_pipeline_run_2026-11-30.log.

Delivering the Drive links now; if Nimbus needs raw logs under NDA we can arrange secure transfer.

Soojín (Sooyin) Lee
Head of Compliance Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sdlc_controls_matrix_v2.xlsx, secrets-management-playbook.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Controlled-change evidence (SDLC) for Nimbus scoped items

Soojín / Neha —

Good start. A few clarifying asks from the sales/security liaison:

1) Nimbus specifically requested "the last production rollback and the reason" for a runtime release in the last 6 months. Can we supply the incident ID and the redacted postmortem excerpt?
2) They want to see actual PR gating artifacts (the CI job output that shows the blocked merge due to failing security scan). Please confirm redaction level — ideally strip any internal hostnames/commit SHAs but keep job names and timestamps.
3) For secrets rotation: can we show the rotation event (timestamp + token-id stub) but not the token itself?

If we can deliver those 3 items in the bundle it will close a majority of the Nimbus questions. I'll coordinate the postmortem excerpt with Product.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@northbridge-assess.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Controlled-change evidence (SDLC) for Nimbus scoped items

Thanks, Marissa. Confirming responses inline: 

1) Rollback: Incident ID INC-2026-1107 corresponds to a canary rollback on 2026-10-29 due to increased tail latency on a GPU pool. I can include the redacted postmortem excerpt (we will remove internal links and user identifiers).

2) PR gating artifact: I'll extract the CI job output for PR #4821 showing the security-scan failure; we will replace full commit SHAs with short stubs (e.g., <commit:abc123>).

3) Secrets rotation: we will include the rotation record (rotation job timestamp and token-id stub) from Secrets Manager (no secret values).

Deliverables will be uploaded to the Drive link and I will attach the redacted CI log file here for quick review. If Northbridge requires a formal NDA addendum to receive raw logs, let me know.

Soojín

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@northbridge-assess.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@nimbus-finance.com>, security.ops@nimbus-finance.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Controlled-change evidence (SDLC) for Nimbus scoped items

Soojín —

This is perfect, thank you. The artifacts in the shared Drive look sufficient for Nimbus' initial assessment; Carlos will follow up if they need raw logs. A couple of small asks before we close the loop: 

- Please confirm the PR gating policy name exactly (we need to reference it in the SIG questionnaire).
- Can you provide the exact timestamp for the rotation event you included (timezone UTC preferred)?

If you can drop those two items into the Drive folder we'll mark this item as satisfied for the SOC 2 / SIG packet.

Best regards,
Elena

Attachments referenced: None
